review:
Ghost Vision is a Hacksaw Gaming slot about a black-ops unit, released on 19 November 2026 with a 96% RTP, high volatility (4 out of 5) and a 10,000x maximum win. The core mechanic is SwitchSpins: a Ghost Vision symbol triggers a respin that selects up to ten paying symbol types and replaces them with wilds, and more Ghost Vision symbols can award further respins and more replacements. Fill the entire grid with wilds and you win the maximum prize.

Three free spins symbols trigger Operation Black Rain, ten free spins with an increased chance of SwitchSpins, while four trigger Project Iron Curtain, ten free spins that progressively collect symbols to replace. Hacksaw also publishes 94%, 92% and 86% RTP versions, so check the setting at your casino. Try the free demo to see how fast a grid fills; it suits players who like Hacksaw's paylines games with one strong gimmick.
